      public CityDTO(String name, String mapName, int centerX, int centerY, List<HouseBlockDTO> blocks)
      Constructs a new CityDTO instance.
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the city
      mapName - the name of the map associated with the city
      centerX - the X-coordinate representing the city's center
      centerY - the Y-coordinate representing the city's center
      blocks - the list of HouseBlockDTO objects representing the blocks in the city
